remaining_doubts: Preload Adjustment Wrench 6081 (30mm) / 6082 (45mm) on page 7-111 has no Series column or badge; left out as standalone parts and recorded only in the 6930-SC/6945-SC notes. Add them if unbadged accessories of F parts should be catalogued.
Included Standard Machining Services 7614 Cut-to-Size and 7616 Offset (page 7-112) carry no series badge; kept in 6930-SR/6945-SR notes rather than as machining_service parts.
Bracket-to-carriage bolts (11-6714, 11-8716, 11-6314, 11-8318) come from tables with no series column; attached to the F plates they are listed for.
Roller track, roller guides and decelerator are categorized linear_motion (Motion Systems section); they are conveyor-type parts and could arguably be accessory/other.
